lessons: ROOT CAUSE worth remembering: the wrong '21-90 day' tik-nisuin window passed every gate for multiple cycles because it HAD a real evidence entry, sourced to nbn.org.il (Nefesh B'Nefesh), a secondary site. The gate checks that a snippet exists at the cited URL, not that the URL is the authoritative issuer. For any rule owned by a ministry, cite the ministry.

Expert CRITICAL deferred: venue business licence (rishayon esek), fire approval and occupancy cap are absent from the vendor red-flags table. Business Licensing Law 1968; the Versailles collapse is why this is separately regulated.

Expert CRITICAL deferred: berur yahadut (Jewish-status inquiry) is reduced to a one-line pitfall. In practice it opens a months-long rabbinical-court track and is the leading cause of a lost wedding date for FSU olim and for couples whose parents married abroad. Tie it to ITIM, which is already linked but not connected to this procedure.

Tooling: verify_legal.py fired REVIEW on this skill because SKILL_HE.md contained 'שימו לב לניסוח: החוק...' meaning 'note the statute's WORDING'. That is a false positive in the documented drafting-keyword family, cleared by the legal-review gate (verdict CLEAR, Tier C) and worked around by rewording to 'נוסח החוק'. The scanner's ninusach false-positive list should get this pattern plus a regression fixture, so the next skill that quotes statutory wording does not re-trip it. Not changed this cycle because scan_catalog.py is shared by 14 pipelines and a mid-batch edit there is not safe.
